name: Climate Change and Adaptation
description: Difference between climate and weather, factors influencing regional and global climate, Greenhouse gas effect, Emissions of short lived climate forcers (SLCPs), climate relevant properties of climate forcers, radiative forcing, historical change in temperature and rainfall, working and goals of organization related to climate change assessment (e.g. IPCC, UNEP etc.), current mitigation policies, current mitigation policies, challenges in climate change adaptation.
